name: Roland Randrody
original_name: ローランド・ランドロ－ディ
source:
The first prince of the kingdom. Because he is a child of a concubine, he has no right of succession to the throne. He excels in both literary and military arts, and is well-liked by his subjects and the people of the kingdom.

There are many who want Roland to succeed to the throne, but he has no intention of doing so and is trying to support his younger brother.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moonparrot.com/html/game/soukoku/chara.html]official website[/url]]
